description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingQueryCommand' within the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.query'. The interface extends another interface 'ThingCommand' and provides methods related to querying the state of 'things', including selecting specific JSON fields for retrieval.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommand
classes.description: Java interface for querying the state of 'things'. It provides default implementations for some methods including 'getSelectedFields' and 'getCategory', and declares an abstract method 'setDittoHeaders'.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonFieldSelector specifying which fields to include in the JSON response when querying a 'thing'. Default implementation returns Optional.empty().

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command. It is an abstract method inherited from 'ThingCommand'.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, defaulting to 'QUERY'.
